description: This file implements functions related to message creation and destruction within the 'transport' namespace of the 'cuttlefish' project. It defines a MessageDestroyer functor for cleaning up RawMessage objects and provides functions to allocate and initialize RawMessage instances with specific command and payload sizes.

classes.name: MessageDestroyer
classes.description: A functor class that destroys RawMessage objects by zeroing out memory and freeing the allocated space.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Destroys a RawMessage by zeroing its memory and freeing it.

methods.name: CreateMessage
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a RawMessage with specified command, response flag, and payload size.

methods.name: CreateMessage (overload)
methods.description: Creates a RawMessage with specified command and payload size, defaulting is_response to false.
